class.name: JRPGCommonEventData
class.brief_description: A common event: commands callable from anywhere.
class.description: Database entry for a command list that events can call, or that runs automatically while a switch is on.

members.member: Switch that must be on for an autorun or parallel common event to run.
When the common event runs by itself: never (only when called), as an autorun, or as a parallel process.

constants.constant: Runs automatically while [member switch_id] is on, blocking other processing.
Runs alongside the game while [member switch_id] is on.
